title: West Coast Spirituality
description: Explores the Pacific Northwest's distinctive approach to the institutions, ideas, and practices associated with religion, culture and spirituality. Uses humanistic and social scientific approaches to reflect on why this "bio-region" seems to be so unusual in North America. Examines secularization, syncretism, Indigenous revitalization and new forms of post- or extra-institutional spirituality. Emphasizes diverse forms of experiential learning.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of RCS 411, RCS 401 (if taken in the same topic), RS 401 (if taken in the same topic).
